generation.gooo_source:
package fillflow
namespace fillflow
entity Integer id "fillflow://integer"
entity Boolean id "fillflow://boolean"

activity Lift(Integer) -> Integer computes "var base = (input + 0)\nvar increment = 1\nreturn base + increment"

activity Scale(Integer) -> Integer computes "var base = (input * 2)\nvar offset = 0\nreturn base + offset"

activity Positive(Integer) -> Boolean computes "return input > 0"
bind Lift.result -> Scale.input
bind Scale.result -> Positive.input
